projects.name: Plants Vs Zombies
projects.desc: A Windows tower-defense game built with C++ and SFML. Place plants, collect suns to fund your defenses, and stop zombie waves before they reach the house.
projects.long: Defend a lawn by placing shooter plants and sunflowers, collecting suns to fund additional plants, and stopping zombies as they move toward the house. Zombies spawn across multiple rows and are attacked by plant-fired projectiles. The game demonstrates a classic event, update, and render loop, with managers coordinating plants, zombies, bullets, suns, and collision handling. SFML provides the graphics, audio, windowing, and input. The repository includes Visual Studio project files for Windows and an architecture diagram.

projects.name: Masm Debugger Clone
projects.desc: A C++ console virtual-machine emulator for exploring a simplified CPU. Execute and step through assembly while inspecting registers, flags, and memory.
projects.long: This educational emulator simulates a basic CPU architecture so users can observe how low-level instructions execute. Enter and run assembly code, step through execution with real-time register updates, and inspect or edit memory with hex dumps. Customizable registers and flags, breakpoints, and memory watches provide tools for tracing program behavior. The project is written in C++ and released under the MIT License.
